# clavis connections test

<p class="cli-lead">Check that a connection works for the syncs that use it</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis connections test ID [flags]
```

</div>

Check that the provider accepts the credential. For Forgejo it also checks Actions access in every repository or organization the connection's syncs push to; `--repo` or `--org` adds one more destination.

## Examples

```sh
clavis connections test 123e4567 --repo team/web
```

## Flags

<dl class="cli-flags">
<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-repo"><dt><code>--repo string</code></dt><dd>Forgejo repository (owner/name) to check as well</dd></div>
</dl>
